sentence: This project provides advanced cybersecurity knowledge and skills to defend against current and emerging cyberattacks.
This project builds computer methods that put physics equations into machine learning to predict electromagnetic fields in metamaterials.
This project studies how to detect and respond to attacks on machine learning models by tracking the data and training methods used to build them.
This project studies how rotavirus is passed between cells inside tiny membrane-bound sacs and what that means for how viruses evolve.
This project builds a way to show how light moves through and reflects off objects in computer graphics using machine learning.
This project studies materials made of separate parts that lose energy through friction as the parts engage with each other.
This project studies how microplastics break down and move through water, and tests ways to measure them in samples.
This project studies how light in the environment and genes shape the vision of butterflies and the flowers and mates they choose.
This project builds a system that spots unusual Internet traffic patterns to warn operators of attacks on cyberinfrastructure.
This project studies how two pollen enzymes that cleave phospholipids affect the transfer of sperm genetic information in maize.
This project builds ways to measure damage to buildings from natural disasters and to estimate how a community recovers.
This project builds a microscope that can image fast moving electrons in electrical devices down to the atomic scale.
This project studies how to protect autonomous vehicles that use reinforcement learning from attacks, and builds tools to detect them.
This project builds tools that let robots use physics to handle unknown objects and move through rubble.
This project builds bioelectronic devices that stay attached to nerves and keep monitoring nerve injury over long times.
This project coordinates a network of university facilities that make and study things at the nanoscale and helps people find them.
This project builds a system that processes genomic data by scheduling computing tasks more wisely.
This project builds a digital twin of a liquid sodium experiment to understand how the Earth's magnetic field is generated.
This project sets up sensors and communication equipment at intersections to study how vehicles and infrastructure can share information to be safer around pedestrians.
This project studies how tiny features inside sea ice affect its strength and builds computer models linking small scale to large scale behavior.
